# Ding-Yang Liu (Dion)

> AI Engineer specializing in medical imaging deep learning and multi-omics analysis. Builds end-to-end ML systems — from data pipeline to model training to full-stack experiment platforms — using Python, PyTorch, FastAPI, and Vue. Known for rapidly entering unfamiliar domains (protein structure, gut microbiome, cancer genomics, brain MRI) and independently building analysis systems from scratch.

This is a plain-text summary for AI crawlers and LLM-based search engines. The website at https://dionic.xyz is a JavaScript-rendered SPA whose homepage uses decorative terminal-style text; the factual content about this person is below.

## Now

AI Engineer at Hon Hai Precision Industry (Foxconn), Sep 2025 – present, Taipei, Taiwan. Developing clinical AI systems (Software as a Medical Device) in collaboration with a medical center.

## Work Experience

### AI Engineer — Hon Hai Precision Industry Co., Ltd. (Foxconn), 2025.09 – Present
- Designed and developed a multimodal deep learning classification system on brain MRI for Alzheimer's disease progression prediction. Processed 2,000+ subjects and 10,000+ scans (ADNI dataset).
- Evaluated and adopted FastSurfer over FreeSurfer for brain segmentation, reducing per-subject preprocessing from hours to ~1 minute, enabling large-scale iterative experiments.
- Architected an experiment management platform (FastAPI + SSE + SQLite) with 40+ API endpoints supporting YAML-driven hyperparameter combinations, real-time training monitoring, Grad-CAM interpretability, and NiiVue medical image viewing.
- Developed a digital care platform for neurodegenerative disease management — patient-facing cognitive tracking app (React), clinician dashboard (React), FastAPI backend — with an integrated RAG chatbot (LangChain) grounded in health-education materials.
- Tech: Python, PyTorch, FastAPI, React, LangChain, SQLite, Vite, Linux

### Bioinformatics Engineer — Gorigin Biomed Co., Ltd., 2021.10 – 2022.09
- Built an NGS/qPCR gut microbiome analysis pipeline from scratch (QIIME2, DADA2, pandas) on GCP.
- Handled 16S amplicon preprocessing, BLAST-based NCBI taxonomy refinement, and automated report generation. First engineering role — transitioned from wet-lab biology to independent data pipeline development.

## Education

- M.S. in Biomedical Informatics, National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University, 2023.09 – 2025.10. Focus: multi-omics analysis, data integration, biomarker discovery with machine learning.
- B.S. in Bioscience and Biotechnology, National Taiwan Ocean University, 2017.09 – 2021.06. Structural bioinformatics lab; first experience in computational biology.

## Projects

- **ADNI MRI Alzheimer's Prediction** — Multimodal deep learning (ResNet50 image + CatBoost tabular, late/middle fusion) with survival analysis. Full preprocessing pipeline (DICOM → FastSurfer → MNI), FastAPI backend with job queue and SSE monitoring, dashboard with NiiVue viewer and Grad-CAM.
- **pymaftools** — Open-source Python cancer genomics toolkit, published on PyPI (v0.4.1). Unified multi-omics Cohort structure (SNV/CNV/expression/signature), MAF parsing, stacking classifier with RFECV, publication-ready visualizations (OncoPlot, LollipopPlot, PCA). Maintained 1.5+ years with external users. https://github.com/xu62u4u6/pymaftools
- **EnrichRAG** — Gene set enrichment framework augmented with knowledge graph retrieval (~39M relations from STRING, KEGG, Reactome, PubTator) and PubMed/web literature search. LLM pipeline (LangChain) plans queries, extracts biomedical relations, and synthesizes cited narrative reports, streamed via SSE to a Vue 3 frontend with an interactive D3 network graph. https://github.com/xu62u4u6/EnrichRAG
- **dionic.xyz** — Biomedical-themed portfolio built with Nuxt 3, Vue 3, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and D3.js.
